meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 写代码，帮你创建 DNA/RNA/蛋白序列并注册实体、管理库存容器与转移、建实验记录条目和 workflow 任务，也能查 Data Warehouse。
howto.when: 当你提到 benchling-sdk、v2 API 等关键词，或要求用 Python 自动化 Benchling 实验室数据时触发。

say.text: 用 Benchling SDK 帮我创建一条环形 DNA 序列并注册为实体
say.note: 会先确认 tenant URL 与 API key

say.text: 写个脚本把指定容器转移到某个 freezer box
帮我从 Data Warehouse 查某段时间的库存变动
say.note: 用 SQL 访问 Benchling 数据

howto.what_en: Claude writes benchling-sdk or v2 API code to create DNA/RNA/protein sequences and registry entities, manage inventory containers and transfers, build ELN entries and workflow tasks, and run Data Warehouse SQL queries.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention benchling-sdk, the v2 API, etc., or ask to automate Benchling lab data with Python.

say_en.text: Create a circular DNA sequence and register it as an entity with the Benchling SDK
say_en.note: Checks tenant URL and API key first

say_en.text: Write a script to transfer a container into a freezer box
Query the Data Warehouse for inventory changes over a date range
